title: 06 부품·사용처
notes: Rebuild: (1) python3 hardware/mechanical/cad/src/locate.py (~15 s; only build_all.collect(), never build_all.main()) writes fin/loc/base_plan.svg, base_side.svg, base_front.svg, overlays.json and detail/.svg (183 figures); (2) python3 docs/report/toccata-v4/src/tabs/parts/build_section.py writes section.html, assets.txt and fin/loc/cards.json. section.html holds the header, filters, the static purchase record (totals asserted equal to data/final_items.json: school 199,960 + school shipping 28,700 + personal 227,166 = 455,826), the dropped list, the print tools/jigs table and one empty anchor per card (ids parts-: item ids i014.., print files p- e.g. p-KEY-C, plywood ply-pod-side/ply-pod-back/ply-pod-top/ply-pod-bottom/ply-cu-back/ply-cu-bottom) so deep links work with the router. script.js fetches fin/loc/cards.json + fin/loc/overlays.json when the section is first shown (MutationObserver on hidden), fills the cards, and draws each location figure lazily (IntersectionObserver): base SVG as + an inline overlay (code from fin/parts/index.json), circuit anchors resolved at runtime (circuit-sch-0n; SCH-06 -> circuit-sch-06-pwr, or circuit-sch-06-ts for cat 터치스크린; else #circuit), #prep-r-. Shared assets also listed: img/bom/*.jpg (from the items step). Dropped item ids in CAD print notes are replaced by the kept item (final_items.json dropped[].replaced_by, e.g. i068 -> i062) in locate.py and build_section.py; i221 (velcro strap) is drawn on its hosts CU-BATFRAME + BAT-LFP, with the strap slots measured on the frame solid.
